properties.description: The Republic Hotel is a historic URM building in the International Special Review District. It is a mixed-use retail and 100% Affordable Housing project that is on the Priority 2 list. The scope of work includes voluntary full seismic upgrades, masonry restoration, window replacement and restoration, adding an elevator, new roofing, and adding a 5th floor penthouse floor. Mechanical and electrical upgrades include new exhaust fans, new heat pumps for heating and cooling, low flow plumbing fixtures, new all building hot and cold water plumbing system, all LED lighting, a new fire sprinkler system, a new fire alarm system. Interior improvements include new cabinets and counter tops, Energy Star appliances, tubs/showers, new flooring, base, and paint throughout. cold shell for the commercial spaces. All new insulation on entire exterior envelope as part of the work. We are looking at 36 family sized units over retail/restaurant space.

properties.description:
Land use pre-sub conference for building permit # 6540641

Modernization of Lincoln High School and Site Improvements. Additions for mechanical spaces and new entry and storage. Reconstructing north parking lot. Demolition of boiler housing structures on the east side of the central wing.

Work under this Contract includes, but is not limited to, the complete interior high school remodel and re-roofing to approx. 178,578 SF of existing 4-story historic landmarked masonry structures, fire alarm upgrades for approx. 70,852 SF of existing 1-story structures (gym, auditorium, classroom annex), and general construction of approx. 11,967 SF of new 3-story building additions.  Building Work includes structural, mechanical, electrical, and food service.  Site Work includes building demolition, utilities, paving, landscaping, irrigation, and related site improvements.  Right of way Work includes curb ramp replacement, sidewalk repairs, and street trees along Interlake Ave N, N 43rd Street, and Woodlawn Ave N.
